== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Luminous [[Queen]] is the [[Monarch]] of the [[Ninecloud Court]], a title associated with [[Luminous Queen Sha Leiala|Sha Leiala]]. While she has reportedly isolated herself following her mother's death, it is suggested that [[Luminous Queen Sha Miara|Sha Miara]] uses a colorful [[madra]] disguise to impersonate her and maintain the illusion that [[Luminous Queen Sha Leiala|Leiala]] is still active. The true identity of the Luminous [[Queen]] is a closely guarded secret, known only to her family, direct subordinates, and other [[Monarchs]]. Her [[Authority|authority]] is significant enough that she can leave behind condensed gems called [[the Queen]]'s Gift, which allow others to utilize her political and conceptual power. The Luminous [[Queen]] is linked to the [[Path of Celestial Radiance]], an ability that permits the transfer of power to an heir. Her court is supported by figures such as her [[Herald]] and Right Hand, [[Sha Relliar]].}}
